outputs.explanation: Panel A is a sequence conservation logo, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
The inhibition zone plot shows mean ± SEM bars with individual gray dots overlaid for each replicate, as stated in the caption and visible in the figure.
Panel C consists of epifluorescence micrographs, not a summary plot.
Fluorescence intensity plot shows mean ± SEM with individual yellow open circles representing individual cells.
Fluorescence intensity plot (log scale) shows mean ± SEM with individual blue open circles representing individual cells.
Panel F shows super-resolution PALM localization images of representative cells, not a quantitative summary plot.
Number of clusters per cell plot shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell.
Cluster size plot (log scale) shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cluster.
Molecule percentage-into-clusters plot shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell.
